result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback position: it limits inspections to once per 12 months, retains the more protective 30-day notice period and business-hours restriction, and keeps all inspection costs with HDI. The sole addition is the needed frequency cap, so the change is minimal and preserves the payment-verification purpose. It does not reach the preferred position because HDI's General Manager, rather than an independent confidentiality-bound auditor, may inspect, and there is no express prohibition on direct systems access. Drafting is clear, though the inherited phrase 'may ... have the right to inspect' is slightly awkward.
